_doc: v2: 'Pehchaan' cut. Kal interview -> binary search in 20 s (one scale) -> Bhai plays the interviewer, 5 real question types, Bro spots the clue -> the 3 clues -> CTA. 'cap' Roman, 'tts' voice text; phrase punctuation must match. Interviewer questions are in English (as in a real Indian interview).

reel.cap: Arre yaar, kal interview hai… aur binary search ka sawaal pehchaan hi nahi paata.
reel.tts: अरे यार, कल interview है… और binary search का सवाल पहचान ही नहीं पाता।

reel.cap: Tension mat le. Pehle 20 second mein binary search samajh.
reel.tts: Tension मत ले. पहले बीस second में binary search समझ.

reel.cap: Sorted list ho, toh seedha beech wala dekh.
reel.tts: Sorted list हो, तो सीधा बीच वाला देख.

reel.cap: Aur target bada nikla toh?
reel.tts: और target बड़ा निकला तो?

reel.cap: Left wala aadha phek de. Chhota nikla, toh right wala.
reel.tts: Left वाला आधा फेंक दे. छोटा निकला, तो right वाला.

reel.cap: Har step pe aadha khatam. 1000 numbers? Sirf 10 step.
reel.tts: हर step पे आधा ख़त्म. एक हज़ार numbers? सिर्फ़ दस step.

reel.cap: Bas? Itna simple?
reel.tts: बस? इतना simple?

reel.cap: Simple hai. Asli game hai pehchaanna. Main interviewer, tu bata.
reel.tts: Simple है. असली game है पहचानना. मैं interviewer, तू बता.

reel.cap: Given a sorted array, find the target.
reel.tts: Given a sorted array, find the target.

reel.cap: Sorted hai, binary search!
reel.tts: Sorted है, binary search!

reel.cap: The sorted array is rotated. Now find the target.
reel.tts: The sorted array is rotated. Now find the target.

reel.cap: Rotated… par ek aadha toh sorted hai. Binary search!
reel.tts: Rotated… पर एक आधा तो sorted है. Binary search!

reel.cap: Find the square root of x. No built-in function.
reel.tts: Find the square root of x. No built-in function.

reel.cap: Isme toh array hi nahi hai…
reel.tts: इसमें तो array ही नहीं है…

reel.cap: Answer 0 se x ke beech hai, aur mid badhe toh mid square bhi badhta hai.
reel.tts: Answer zero से x के बीच है, और mid बढ़े तो mid square भी बढ़ता है.

reel.cap: Matlab range sorted hai… answer pe binary search!
reel.tts: मतलब range sorted है… answer पे binary search!

reel.cap: Find the minimum speed to finish all work in 6 days.
reel.tts: Find the minimum speed to finish all work in six days.

reel.cap: Minimum, jo shart poori kare. Answer pe binary search!
reel.tts: Minimum, जो शर्त पूरी करे. Answer पे binary search!

reel.cap: Aur agar bole: do it in O of log n…
reel.tts: और अगर बोले: do it in O of log n…

reel.cap: …toh pakka binary search!
reel.tts: तो पक्का binary search!

reel.cap: Bas teen ishaare: sorted, log n, ya minimum-maximum jo shart poori kare.
reel.tts: बस तीन इशारे: sorted, log n, या minimum-maximum जो शर्त पूरी करे.

reel.cap: Ab kal toh phod dunga!
reel.tts: अब कल तो फोड़ दूँगा!

reel.cap: Aise 10 interview favourite sawaal chahiye? Comment karo "BINARY".
reel.tts: ऐसे ten interview favourite सवाल चाहिए? Comment करो binary.
